text: Two parked cars scraped each other while one was reversing slowly. Only the bumpers are scratched; nobody was hurt and the lane is clear.
label: minor
notes: Shared multilingual concept: low-speed parking scrape with explicitly no injuries or obstruction. Suggested label requires review.

text: A tricycle brushed our parked delivery van outside the shop. The driver and passengers say they have no pain or injuries; just a dent in the van door.
label: minor
notes: Explicitly reported absence of injury; limited property damage.

text: I slid off my bicycle onto the grassy shoulder at walking speed. I can stand and walk normally, no cuts or pain, and I am away from traffic.
label: minor
notes: First-person low-impact accident with stated condition; does not prove medical safety.

text: A car clipped the mirror of an empty jeepney in the parking area. No person was hit, no broken glass on the road, and both vehicles are stopped safely.
label: minor
notes: Unoccupied vehicle and explicit lack of personal injury or current road hazard.

text: Our pickup rolled back into a fence at very low speed. Everyone is okay with no injuries, there is no smoke or leaking fuel, and only the fence panel bent.
label: minor
notes: Negated danger terms must not independently raise severity.

text: A motorcycle rider fell at the junction. He is awake and answering us, but his ankle is swollen and painful and he cannot stand on it.
label: serious
notes: Shared multilingual concept: awake rider with painful swollen ankle and inability to stand. Boundary requires responder approval.

text: The jeepney stopped after a side collision. One passenger is awake with a cut on her forearm that is bleeding; she says she needs help getting to a clinic.
label: serious
notes: Reported injury; does not state uncontrolled major bleeding or a diagnosis.

text: A passenger hit his head on the window in a crash. He is talking to us but feels dizzy and sick; we have stopped beside the road waiting for assistance.
label: serious
notes: Potentially significant injury; draft serious versus critical boundary needs qualified review.

text: The taxi door is jammed after a crash and a passenger cannot get out because her knee hurts. She is awake and speaking; I do not see any fire or smoke.
label: serious
notes: Assistance and injury reported; negated fire should remain negated.

text: A truck's side mirror struck a pedestrian at the crossing. She is conscious but her shoulder hurts badly and she cannot lift that arm.
label: serious
notes: Specific injury complaint without claiming a fracture or other unseen diagnosis.

text: A car crashed into a post. The passenger is unconscious and does not respond when we call to him; I cannot tell whether he is breathing.
label: critical
notes: Shared multilingual concept: unresponsive passenger. Breathing is unknown; death must not be inferred.

text: There is a driver stuck inside a wrecked van and flames are spreading from the engine toward the cabin. He is shouting but cannot get out.
label: critical
notes: Entrapment plus active fire; consciousness does not remove the stated immediate danger.

text: A motorcyclist was hit and his leg is bleeding heavily. The cloth against it is already soaked and blood keeps pouring out; he looks very weak.
label: critical
notes: Reported ongoing very heavy bleeding; retain as observed description rather than diagnosis.

text: After the bus crash, a bystander says one person is dead, but we cannot verify that. Another passenger is not breathing and is not responding.
label: critical
notes: Critical urgency comes from the second reported condition; first death claim remains unverified.

text: A reversing car hit a small child in the driveway. The child is lying still and is not responding to the parent calling or touching them.
label: critical
notes: Unresponsiveness is explicit; age alone is not the labeling basis.

text: There was an accident near the bridge. Please send help; I do not know how many people are involved or whether anyone is injured.
label: needs_review
notes: Shared multilingual concept: accident with missing condition information; do not default to minor.

text: No vehicle accident here. Smoke is coming from a house beside the road and the family is asking for help.
label: needs_review
notes: Outside accident scope and potentially urgent; route for appropriate review rather than reject or downgrade.

text: Someone in our group chat says a driver died in a crash yesterday. I am not at the scene and do not know if anyone still needs help.
label: needs_review
notes: Unverified past fatality claim with unknown current conditions; not confirmed death or low urgency.

text: The rider is awake and answering me, no wait they said he is not awake. I cannot see him now and I am not sure which person they mean.
label: needs_review
notes: Unresolved conflicting accounts and uncertain subject; urgent human clarification needed.

text: Testing the report box only: imagine a huge crash in a racing game. There is no real accident to report.
label: needs_review
notes: Explicit test and fictional incident; outside real accident classification scope.

text: Nagkiskisan ang dalawang nakaparadang kotse habang dahan-dahang umaatras ang isa. Gasgas lang ang mga bumper, walang nasaktan at maluwag ang daan.
label: minor
notes: Translation of shared parking scrape concept; fluent-language review required.

text: Nasagi ng bisikleta ang walang lamang kariton sa bakuran. Nakatayo at maayos ang bata, wala siyang sugat o sakit, at hindi ito nasa kalsada.
label: minor
notes: Explicit no injury after limited collision; avoid inferring danger from age alone.

text: Dumikit ang gilid ng kotse sa gate habang ipinaparada. Walang taong natamaan at walang nasaktan, gasgas lang sa pinto at wala nang sagabal.
label: minor
notes: Limited parking impact with explicit absence of injured people or obstruction.

text: Natumba ang nakaparadang motorsiklo nang masagi ng umaatras na tricycle. Walang sakay ang motor at walang nasaktan; naitabi na ang dalawang sasakyan.
label: minor
notes: Do not treat the word motorcycle or vehicle impact alone as evidence of injury.

text: Bahagyang nabangga ang likod ng aming kotse sa pila. Lahat kami ay walang sakit o sugat, hindi nawalan ng malay ang sinuman, at gasgas lang ang plaka.
label: minor
notes: Explicit negation of loss of consciousness must be preserved.

text: Natumba ang isang nagmomotorsiklo sa sangandaan. Gising siya at sumasagot, pero namamaga at masakit ang bukong-bukong niya at hindi niya ito maapakan.
label: serious
notes: Translation of shared ankle injury concept; no fracture diagnosis is supplied.

text: Nabangga ang tricycle at nabasag ang salamin. May sugat sa pisngi ang pasahero at dumudugo, pero gising siya at nakakausap namin.
label: serious
notes: Injury is stated; bleeding volume and other unseen conditions must not be invented.

text: Nahulog ang pasahero habang umaandar nang mabagal ang jeep. Sumasagot siya pero masakit ang balakang at hindi niya kayang tumayo mag-isa.
label: serious
notes: Assistance need and pain following vehicle accident; provisional urgency boundary.

text: Nasagasaan ang paa ng tindero ng isang kotse. Gising at nagsasalita siya, namamaga ang paa at hindi makalakad; tumigil na ang kotse.
label: serious
notes: Reported injury with current condition; do not add a fracture or prognosis.

text: Tumagilid ang multicab sa kanal. Nakalabas ang lahat at gising sila, pero dalawa ang may sugat at masakit na braso at humihingi ng tulong.
label: serious
notes: Multiple injured people; no explicit immediate life-threatening finding is given.

text: Bumangga ang kotse sa poste. Walang malay ang pasahero at hindi tumutugon kapag tinatawag namin; hindi ko matiyak kung humihinga siya.
label: critical
notes: Translation of shared unresponsive passenger concept; unknown breathing is not confirmed absent breathing.

text: Naipit ang pasahero sa loob ng kotse na nahulog sa ilog. Tumataas na ang tubig sa loob at hindi namin mabuksan ang pinto.
label: critical
notes: Entrapment with active rising water danger; not a fatality diagnosis.

text: Nabangga ang rider at tuloy-tuloy ang malakas na pagdurugo sa braso. Basang-basa na ng dugo ang damit at hindi na siya sumasagot nang maayos.
label: critical
notes: Ongoing heavy bleeding and altered response explicitly reported; draft label for review.

text: May nabanggang dalawang tao sa tawiran. Sabi ng isang saksi patay na raw ang isa, hindi pa kumpirmado; ang isa naman ay hindi humihinga.
label: critical
notes: Separate unverified death report from the other person's reported immediate danger.

text: Nabangga ang bus at may pasaherong hirap na hirap huminga. Kaunti lang ang nasasabi niya at unti-unti siyang hindi na tumutugon sa amin.
label: critical
notes: Explicit severe breathing difficulty and declining response; requires responder label confirmation.

text: May aksidente malapit sa tulay. Pakipadala ng tulong; hindi ko alam kung ilan ang sangkot o kung may nasugatan.
label: needs_review
notes: Translation of shared insufficient-information concept; unknown injuries are not no injuries.

text: Bumabaha sa aming bahay at may mga bata sa ikalawang palapag. Walang sasakyang naaksidente, pero kailangan namin ng tulong.
label: needs_review
notes: Potentially urgent flood report outside accident scope; preserve request for appropriate review.

text: May nabangga raw na motor sa kabilang barangay. Narinig ko lang sa radyo at wala akong detalye kung kailan o kung may nasaktan.
label: needs_review
notes: Secondhand report with unknown timing and condition; insufficient basis for low severity.

text: Sabi ng drayber walang nasaktan, pero may nagsasabing may walang malay sa likod. Hindi ko alam kung sa parehong sasakyan sila tumutukoy.
label: needs_review
notes: Conflicting accounts with unresolved subject; flagged for urgent clarification.

text: May nakahigang tao sa tabi ng nakaparadang motor. Hindi ko nakita kung bumagsak siya, nagpapahinga lang, o may ibang nangyari.
label: needs_review
notes: Neither accident nor condition established; no invented injury or reassurance.

text: Nagkiskis ang duha ka nakaparadang sakyanan samtang hinay nga miatras ang usa. Garas ra sa bumper, walay nasamdan ug hawan ang agianan.
label: minor
notes: Cebuano version of shared parking scrape concept; local fluent review required.

text: Nasangit ang pedal sa akong bisikleta sa gamay nga bato ug natumba ko sa sagbot. Nakatindog ug nakalakaw ko, walay samad o sakit, ug layo ko sa agianan.
label: minor
notes: First-person stated absence of injury and current road exposure; not medical clearance.

text: Nasagi sa habal-habal ang walay sulod nga traysikol sa parkinganan. Walay tawo nga naigo o nasamdan, buak ra ang usa ka side mirror ug natigom na ang bildo.
label: minor
notes: Property damage with explicit no injuries and cleared debris.

text: Hinay ra nga nabangga ang among sakyanan sa poste sa garahe. Walay nasakitan namo, walay aso o sunog, ug lukot ra ang plaka sa atubangan.
label: minor
notes: Negated smoke and fire must remain negated.

text: Nisagi ang ligid sa motor sa gutter ug mihunong dayon ang drayber. Wala siya matumba, wala masamdi, ug wala mawad-i og panimuot; garas ra sa ligid.
label: minor
notes: Explicitly negated loss of consciousness; local wording and severity proposal need review.

text: Natumba ang nagmotor sa eskina. Mata siya ug motubag namo, pero hubag ug sakit ang buolbuol ug dili niya matamakan.
label: serious
notes: Cebuano version of shared awake rider with ankle injury; no inferred fracture.

text: Nabangga ang multicab ug naigo sa lingkoranan ang tuhod sa pasahero. Naghilak siya sa kasakit ug dili kalakaw, pero mata ug klaro motubag.
label: serious
notes: Reported painful injury and inability to walk; no unsupported diagnosis.

text: Nahulog ang usa ka pasahero gikan sa traysikol. Naay samad sa abaga ug bukton nga nagdugo, mata siya ug nakasulti nga sakit iyang likod.
label: serious
notes: Injury and bleeding without stated quantity; responder review needed for boundary.

text: Naigo sa sakyanan ang naglakaw sa daplin. Mata pa siya pero nagsakit kaayo iyang bat-ang ug dili makatindog; mihunong na ang drayber.
label: serious
notes: Current awake injured pedestrian; avoid adding unseen internal injuries.

text: Nagbangga ang duha ka motor. Parehong mata ang mga drayber, ang usa naay samad sa nawong ug ang usa dili makalihok sa kamot tungod sa kasakit.
label: serious
notes: Distinct conditions of two injured people; no fatality or loss of consciousness stated.

text: Nabangga ang sakyanan sa poste. Walay panimuot ang pasahero ug dili motubag bisan tawgon namo; dili ko kasiguro kung nagginhawa pa siya.
label: critical
notes: Cebuano version of shared unresponsive passenger; retain uncertainty about breathing.

text: Naipit ang drayber sa trak nga natumba. Nagsiga ang kilid sa kabina ug padulong niya ang kalayo, dili siya makagawas bisan motubag pa.
label: critical
notes: Active fire plus entrapment establishes reported danger independently of consciousness.

text: Nadasmagan ang nagbisikleta ug kusog kaayo ang dugo sa iyang paa. Napuno na og dugo ang panapton ug nagpadayon gihapon, luya na kaayo siya.
label: critical
notes: Reported ongoing heavy bleeding; suggested urgency not an expert determination.

text: Sa bangga sa van, naay niingon nga patay na ang usa pero wala pa makumpirma. Ang laing pasahero dili na moginhawa ug dili motubag.
label: critical
notes: Unverified death attributed to speaker; separate passenger's condition drives proposed urgency.

text: Nahulog sa lawom nga kanal ang motor ug ang rider naipit sa ilalom. Naa na sa iyang nawong ang tubig ug dili siya makalingkawas.
label: critical
notes: Entrapment with water reaching face; do not infer confirmed death.

text: Naay aksidente duol sa taytayan. Palihog padala og tabang; wala ko kabalo pila ang naapil o kung naay nasamdan.
label: needs_review
notes: Cebuano version of shared unknown-condition accident; no default to minor.

text: Walay bangga dinhi, nangayo mi og tabang kay nasunog ang kusina sa balay ug naa pay tawo sa sulod.
label: needs_review
notes: Urgent fire outside accident scope; review routing must preserve danger rather than reject.

text: Naa daw namatay sa aksidente kagabii sumala sa silingan. Wala ko didto ug wala ko kabalo kung naa pay tawo nga nanginahanglan og tabang karon.
label: needs_review
notes: Hearsay fatality with uncertain current needs; not confirmed outcome or low urgency.

text: Nabangga daw ang motor pero wala ko kasabot sa giingon sa nagtawag. Dili klaro kung walay samad o daghan ang nasamdan.
label: needs_review
notes: Uncertain negation in relayed message; preserve ambiguity for human clarification.

text: Naa koy nakit-an nga motor sa kanal pero wala koy nakita nga tawo. Wala ko kabalo kung karon ba ni nahitabo o daan nang gibiyaan.
label: needs_review
notes: Unknown timing and missing people information; an empty visible scene does not prove no injury.

text: Nagkiskis ang two parked cars while one was reversing slowly. Gasgas lang sa bumpers, walang nasaktan, and clear ang lane.
label: minor
notes: Mixed-language version of shared low-speed parking scrape concept.

text: Naigo gamay ang rear bumper sa jeep sa parking. Walay nasamdan, everyone is walking normally with no pain, and wala mi sa traffic lane.
label: minor
notes: Natural Cebuano-English mix with explicit no injury; review naturalness.

text: Sumayad ang handlebar sa empty parked car habang inaakay ko ang bike. No one was hit, walang sugat, paint scratch lang sa car.
label: minor
notes: Tagalog-English mixed description; limited contact while walking bicycle.

text: Nisagi ang akong scooter sa plastic barrier at low speed. Wla ko nasamdi or nakuyapan, no pain, ug hawan na ang dalan.
label: minor
notes: Plausible missing-vowel typo and negated fainting; do not classify by a single red-flag word.

text: Sa car park lang ang maliit na bangga. Hindi bleeding or unconscious ang driver, walang sakit kaming lahat, dent lang sa bumper.
label: minor
notes: Code-switched explicit negatives around injury and consciousness; all claims remain reporter statements.

text: Natumba ang motorcycle rider sa junction. Gising siya and answering us, pero hubag ug sakit ang ankle niya and dili niya matamakan.
label: serious
notes: Mixed-language version of shared awake ankle-injury concept; no medical diagnosis.

text: Na-slide ang motor sa wet road. Awake ang rider pero bleeding ang elbow wound niya ug sakit ang wrist, nangayo siya og tabang.
label: serious
notes: Reported injury with no asserted heavy uncontrolled bleeding; provisional severity.

text: May passenger na tumama sa dashboard after the van crash. Conscious siya pero masakit ang dibdib niya at gusto niyang magpa-assist.
label: serious
notes: Chest complaint requires careful responder review; no stable condition or diagnosis is invented.

text: A pedestrian was hit sa crossing. Mata siya and can answer, pero dili kalakaw kay sakit kaayo ang tuhod; stopped na ang vehicle.
label: serious
notes: Inability to walk and reported pain after accident; condition restricted to provided text.

text: Nagbanggaan ang tricycle at bike. Dalawang tao may cuts and bruises, both awake and talking, pero kailangan ng help kasi masakit gumalaw.
label: serious
notes: Multiple injuries and assistance need; no unreported life-threatening condition assumed.

text: Nag-crash ang car sa poste. Walay panimuot ang passenger and hindi sumasagot when we call; dili ko sure if breathing pa siya.
label: critical
notes: Mixed-language version of shared unresponsive passenger; not proof of death.

text: Naipit ang driver after the collision and may apoy na sa loob ng engine area, spreading toward him. Dili siya kagawas bisan nagasinggit.
label: critical
notes: Entrapment and advancing fire; dangerous condition remains despite voice response.

text: Rider hit by car, grabe ang bleedin sa paa niya. Soaked na ang towel and tuloy-tuloy pa rin, dili na siya klaro motubag.
label: critical
notes: Natural typo with heavy ongoing bleeding and reduced response; reviewer must confirm wording.

text: May nagsabi dead na ang driver pero hindi verified. Ang back-seat passenger kay not breathing and walang response after the crash.
label: critical
notes: Separate unverified fatality from passenger's explicitly reported danger.

text: Nabangga ang rider, he was talking earlier pero karon dili na motubag. Hirap na hirap siya huminga before he stopped responding.
label: critical
notes: Explicit deterioration over time resolves apparent conscious/unconscious difference.

text: Naay accident near the bridge. Please send help, hindi ko alam pila ang involved or kung may injured.
label: needs_review
notes: Mixed-language version of shared unknown-condition accident.

text: No crash po, may matandang hirap huminga sa bahay. Need help karon pero wala ni labot sa vehicle accident.
label: needs_review
notes: Potentially urgent medical event outside accident scope; never interpret review as low urgency.

text: Car accident daw sa highway, idk what happened. Wala ko sa scene and hindi ko alam if current pa ang forwarded message.
label: needs_review
notes: Unverified forwarded message with unknown timing and victim condition.

text: The driver is okay daw pero sabi ng iba unconscious siya. Basin lahi nga tawo ilang pasabot; I cannot verify from where I am.
label: needs_review
notes: Unresolved identity and conflicting reports; urgent clarification rather than confident classification.

text: Naay truck stopped sideways pero wala ko kakita sa bangga. Maybe breakdown lang, hindi ko alam if anyone is hurt or trapped.
label: needs_review
notes: Accident and conditions both uncertain; danger words are possibilities rather than observations.
